scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Complete corresponding rigid fixed-hand history and retained failed nonlinear free-body coordinate experiment

rigid_fixture_audit.scope: Audit fixed-hand rigid history, temporary support motion and static diagnostics.
rigid_fixture_audit.limitations: Static wrench/span diagnostics are not dynamic equilibrium errors or global Coulomb feasibility proofs. Sampled histories do not prove temporal convergence. The held rigid weld is compliant whereas the current independent initializer pins six displacement rows. Full arm PD and soft finger equality are omitted; no rigid/deformable feedback accuracy is inferred until supports/history, corresponding solved contact and temporal/spatial/regularization axes are qualified.

rigid_mode_release_diagnostics.scope: Audit retained incomplete Panda closure/release states without accepting them.
rigid_mode_release_diagnostics.limitations: These fields come from incomplete free-body contact states. The held closure still contains support reactions. Neither state establishes complete equilibrium, spatial/regularization/history convergence or accuracy against the actual application. Force/moment residuals retain gravity and all nonlinear-body nodes.

temporal_axis.limitations: Comparison uses physical_substep0 at identical macro ticks, without interpolation. Original controls, supports, geometry, material and total52s history remain fixed. Position relative differences include the common world offset; absolute translation and orientation differences must also be inspected. Temporal agreement is separate from contact regularization and physical model/deformation feedback. Persisting angular motion prevents static-contact acceptance; no stress accuracy or physical operating range is inferred.

limitations: Complete rigid fixed-hand protocol and unique same-substep force/pose frames are retained. The body still rotates after20s released hold; small translational speed and nearly stable normal force do not prove a static reference. The temporary compliant weld differs from the independent held-row initializer. Full arm PD/soft finger equality are omitted. Rigid-mode free-body reference still fails its original solver gate, and its global forces/moments/stresses remain unaccepted. Completed2/4/8-substep histories are compared at identical physical times without interpolation. Temporal agreement is not contact-regularization or model/deformation-feedback accuracy. Live U/full-egg are excluded. Corresponding solved deformable/dynamic contact, full convergence/model/feedback and physical accuracy/cost remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
